statement: There are absolute constants C and y0 such that the following holds. Let y ≥ y0, put By = log2 y, and let b be an integer with 1 ≤ b ≤ By. Suppose that real cutoffs satisfy Y0 = y, ee ≤ S ≤ Yb, Yj+1 < Uj < Yj (0 ≤ j < b). 17 Put νj = log2 Yj By (0 ≤ j ≤ b), µj = log2 Uj By (0 ≤ j < b), δ = s log2 S By . Fix a positive integer D with P+(D) ≤ Yb and a real r ≥ 1. Let N count the ordered tuples (p0, . . . , pb−1, q0, . . . , qb−1, D′ ) in which D′ is a positive integer and the following conditions hold: (i) The pj, qj are S-normal primes, pj ̸= qj, and Uj ≤ P+ (pj − 1), P+ (qj − 1) ≤ Yj (0 ≤ j < b). (ii) P+(D′) ≤ Yb and D b−1 Y j=0 (pj − 1) = D′ b−1 Y j=0 (qj − 1) ≤ y r . (iii) The common product in (ii) is squarefree on primes greater than Yb. (iv) The part of p0 − 1 supported above Y1 exceeds √ y. Then N ≤ y rD (CB6 y)b (b + 1)Ω(D) (log Yb)1+3b log(b(b+1)) × (log y) −2+ Pb−1 j=1 ajνj+Eb , (4.4) where Eb = 2 b−1 X j=1 (νj − µj) + δ b X i=2 (i log i + i). (4.5) Here aj is as defined in (2.1). Empty sums are zero; in particular, when b = 1 the cutoff in (iv) is Y1 = Yb.
